title: Biolicious
description: A mod that adds numerous biomes, plants, and decorations to your Minecraft worlds!
body:
In Biolicious, take control of your minecraft experience with tons of new biomes, such as the Orchard and Lavender feild, as well as many new blocks to fit, such as Mahogany, Lepiododendron, Puffballs, Salt, and many plants. This mod also adds a new dungeon-like structure, in which you may just find a new music disc, and some rather ominous decorations. If this sounds appealing to you, then Biolicious may just be right for you! 
Also, I highly reccomend the following mod to go with this one:
https://modrinth.com/mod/jei/version/20.0.0.4
